description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 60s with short graying hair, wearing a comfortable batik-patterned short-sleeve shirt in light blue and beige, paired with dark trousers and simple sandals.

FULL BODY. An anonymous and featureless human silhouette standing in a dark room. The figure is solid black with glowing faint digital circuitry lines tracing over its surface, wearing a dark hooded sweatshirt that obscures the face entirely.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her late 30s with a professional appearance. She is wearing a modern Baju Kurung in a soft lavender color, dark formal shoes, and her hair is neatly tied back in a low bun.
FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in a sharp, dark navy blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform, including a peaked cap, polished black tactical boots, and official insignia on the shoulders.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his early 40s with a clean-shaven face and short, disciplined haircut. He wears a high-ranking PDRM officer's uniform consisting of a dark blue tactical shirt with merit ribbons, matching trousers, and polished black leather boots.
